name: Augment Swap: All-Chrome Edition
description: A Vantablack Media spin-off of the original Augment Swap format, this edition pairs Tier 4 and Tier 5 participants who temporarily exchange their full augmentation loadouts — not just individual pieces but entire integrated chrome profiles, including proprioception mods, sensory filters, and cognitive assist packages. The disorientation, identity crisis, and occasional medical emergencies are presented as entertainment. Contestants sign extensive liability waivers.
cultural_impact: All-Chrome Edition sparked a genuine public conversation about augmentation identity and bodily sovereignty that outlasted the show's entertainment cycle, feeding into the Sovereign Body movement.
story_hooks: A contestant from a sealed episode contacts the party claiming they never received their original augments back — and that someone else is walking around with their cognitive profile
The party is hired to quietly acquire footage from the removed Delacroix-Mamba episode before Vantablack's legal team finishes scrubbing it
A black-market augment dealer is using All-Chrome Edition's swap logistics network as cover for moving stolen military-grade chrome
